summary_zh: 泰國對EV課徵35%稅，促使中國EV品牌加速在泰設廠，零跑（LEAPMOTOR）赴BOI洽談建廠，中資ZD Energy擴建春武里工廠，汽車零件業者轉型EV的產線與技能調整壓力上升。同時泰國推出MOU U-TURN配套，放寬緬甸與寮國勞工合法引進程序，華商可藉此緩解缺工。
summary_en: Thailand's 35% EV tax is pushing Chinese EV brands to build local plants; LEAPMOTOR met BOI and ZD Energy expands in Chonburi, raising pressure on auto parts makers to shift to EV. New MOU U-TURN measures ease legal hiring of Myanmar and Lao foreign workers in Thailand.
